The photo shows a single slice of sourdough-style bread on a square plate.

Plate size: the plate spans roughly 160–600 px, about 440 px. If it is a ~24 cm side plate, that is about 18 px per cm.

Bread size: the slice is about 230 px wide (245–475) and about 255 px tall (105–362). That works out to roughly 13 cm by 14 cm, which is a large slice. Thickness is probably about 1.5–2 cm.

Weight: the slice has an open crumb, and its area is about 150 cm². At 1.5 cm thick that is about 225 cm³. At a density of about 0.25 g/cm³, the slice weighs about 55–60 g. A large sourdough slice usually weighs 50–70 g, so I'll use 60 g.

Energy: bread runs about 2.6 kcal/g, so 60 g is about 156 kcal. I'll round to 160.
